name: claude-noti
description: macOS system notifications when Claude Code needs your permission or input. Click the notification to jump straight back to the right VS Code window.

claudeNoti.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch. When off, no system notifications are sent and the hook payloads are ignored.

claudeNoti.events.permissionPrompt.markdownDescription: Notify when Claude asks for permission to run a tool (`permission_prompt`).

claudeNoti.events.idlePrompt.markdownDescription: Notify when Claude has been waiting for your input (`idle_prompt`).

claudeNoti.events.agentNeedsInput.markdownDescription: Notify when a subagent or an MCP server needs an answer (`agent_needs_input`, `elicitation_dialog`).

claudeNoti.events.stop.markdownDescription: Notify when Claude finishes a turn. Subagent completions are always ignored, otherwise this would fire constantly.

claudeNoti.suppressWhenFocused.markdownDescription: Skip the system notification when this VS Code window already has focus — you are looking at it, so an in-window message is used instead.

claudeNoti.notifierPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `alerter` binary. Leave empty to auto-detect on `PATH` and in the usual Homebrew locations.

claudeNoti.impersonateEditor.markdownDescription: Post notifications under the editor's bundle identifier so they carry its icon. **Likely to stop notifications appearing at all.** macOS only displays a notification whose sender is registered with Notification Center, and testing on macOS 26 showed anything other than alerter's default `com.apple.Terminal` being dropped silently. Leave this off unless you have turned it on, run **Claude Noti: Send Test Notification**, and actually seen the notification.

claudeNoti.sound.markdownDescription: Sound to play with the notification, e.g. `default` or `Glass`. Empty means silent.

claudeNoti.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Auto-close the notification after this many seconds. `0` means it waits until you act on it, which is the point when you have stepped away from the machine — a notification that expires while you are in another app is one you never see. Each waiting notification holds one background process, capped at five.

claudeNoti.minIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Drop repeat notifications for the same session that arrive within this window.

claudeNoti.notifyUnmatchedSessions.markdownDescription: Also notify for Claude Code sessions whose working directory is not inside any open workspace. One window is elected to handle these, so you get a single notification.

claudeNoti.onFocusCommands.markdownDescription: Command IDs to run after the window is brought to the front, e.g. `workbench.action.terminal.focus`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Install into `~/.claude/settings.json` — applies to every project.
Install into `.claude/settings.json` of the current workspace folder.
claudeNoti.hookScope.markdownDescription: Where **Claude Noti: Install Claude Code Hooks** writes the hook entries.
